text.headline: Timeline of Democratic Republic of the Congo
text.text: Major events in the history of Democratic Republic of the Congo.

events.headline: Early Human Settlement
events.text: Archaeological evidence suggests that humans have inhabited the region of present-day Democratic Republic of the Congo since at least 5000 BC, with various hunter-gatherer societies emerging.

events.headline: Formation of Kingdoms
events.text: By the first millennium AD, several kingdoms, including the Kingdom of Kongo, began to form in the region, establishing trade networks and cultural exchanges.

events.headline: Arrival of the Portuguese
events.text: Portuguese explorer Diogo Cão arrives at the mouth of the Congo River, marking the beginning of European contact with the region.

events.headline: Establishment of the Congo Free State
events.text: King Leopold II of Belgium claims the Congo Free State as his personal possession, leading to widespread exploitation and atrocities against the local population.

events.headline: Congo Becomes Belgian Colony
events.text: International outrage over the abuses in the Congo Free State leads to its annexation by Belgium, becoming a Belgian colony.

events.headline: Independence from Belgium
events.text: The Democratic Republic of the Congo gains independence from Belgium, with Patrice Lumumba becoming the first Prime Minister.

events.headline: Assassination of Patrice Lumumba
events.text: Prime Minister Patrice Lumumba is assassinated, leading to a period of political instability and conflict.

events.headline: Mobutu Sese Seko Takes Power
events.text: General Mobutu Sese Seko seizes power in a coup, establishing a dictatorship that lasts for over three decades.

events.headline: Mobutu Overthrown
events.text: Mobutu is overthrown by Laurent-Désiré Kabila, marking the end of his long rule and the beginning of a new era.

events.headline: First Congo War
events.text: The First Congo War begins, involving multiple African nations and leading to millions of deaths and widespread devastation.

events.headline: Assassination of Laurent-Désiré Kabila
events.text: President Laurent-Désiré Kabila is assassinated, leading to his son Joseph Kabila assuming the presidency amidst ongoing conflict.

events.headline: End of Second Congo War
events.text: The Second Congo War officially ends with the signing of peace agreements, although violence continues in various regions.

events.headline: First Democratic Elections
events.text: The Democratic Republic of the Congo holds its first democratic elections since independence, with Joseph Kabila elected as president.

events.headline: Controversial Elections
events.text: Presidential elections are held, but are marred by allegations of fraud and violence, leading to widespread unrest.

events.headline: New Presidential Elections
events.text: After years of political tension, new presidential elections are held, resulting in Félix Tshisekedi becoming president.

events.headline: COVID-19 Pandemic
events.text: The COVID-19 pandemic reaches the Democratic Republic of the Congo, impacting public health and the economy.

events.headline: Political and Social Unrest
events.text: The country faces ongoing political and social unrest, with protests against government policies and economic challenges.

events.headline: Continued Conflict in Eastern DRC
events.text: The eastern regions of the Democratic Republic of the Congo continue to experience violence and conflict, with various armed groups operating in the area.
